name: Saionji Masaya
source:
Masaya is the fourth son of the Saionji family and [url/=c123721]Masaki[/url]'s twin brother. He is a second year student at Saionji Academy and the captain of the soccer team at his school. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%81%8B%E4%BA%BA%E3%81%AF%E5%90%8C%E5%B1%85%E4%BA%BA]Wikipedia[/url].]
